_note: Distributed via Cloudflare R2 (primary, free egress) with a HuggingFace mirror. SHA-256 verifies integrity regardless of which CDN serves the bytes. To add a pack: edit this file, push, the next Aurora install picks it up. To revoke a pack: change its sha256 (forces re-download) or remove the entry.

packs.name: Financial markets & quantitative finance
packs.description: Cited entries covering volatility regimes, momentum / mean-reversion, anomaly events, Granger causality applied to asset prices, term-structure inversion, options & vol, and quant-style time-series analysis. Sourced from arXiv (q-fin.ST), seminal textbooks, and FRED metadata.

packs.name: Industrial sensors & predictive maintenance
packs.description: Cited entries for vibration analysis, bearing failure signatures, pump and motor performance, manufacturing-line anomaly detection, and physical-model fits common in industrial telemetry. Sourced from NREL public datasets, ISO standards, and applied-physics journals.

packs.name: Climate, weather, and environmental science
packs.description: Cited entries for atmospheric and ocean dynamics, El Niño / ENSO regime detection, Pierson-Moskowitz wave spectra, diurnal cycles, NOAA buoy telemetry, and seasonal-cycle decomposition. Sourced from IPCC reports, NOAA technical handbooks, and peer-reviewed climatology.

packs.name: Biomedical & physiological signals
packs.description: Cited entries for ECG / heart-rate-variability analysis, EEG signal processing, ICU early-warning patterns, epidemiology time series, and clinical-trial dose-response. Sourced from PMC Open Access, PhysioNet method papers, and canonical biomedical signal-processing textbooks.
